learning_outcomes.text: Independently create and read a standard-compliant technical drawing.
Recognize faulty drawings and incorporate improvements.
Recognize complex relationships within a technical drawing.
Explain technical representations in an interdisciplinary team.
Utilize an exemplary CAD software system for creating simple components and standard-compliant drawings.
Recognize the benefit of computer-aided design (CAD) for creating simple assemblies.
Independently plan, organize, and execute work steps for drawing creation and simple constructions.
Grasp an interdisciplinary task and develop a solution in teamwork.

assessment_methods.method: Overall result of the CAD application project

assessment_rules: To participate in technical drawing exercises, a corresponding online self-test (Moodle) must be successfully completed. All technical drawing exercises must be submitted and graded at least "sufficient". Submission deadlines must be met. The CAD exercise part includes a semester-long application project. For successful completion, two intermediate results (Testate) must be passed, and the overall result of the application project must be submitted. If an exercise (technical drawing) is not submitted or not rated "sufficient" after the semester, the student will receive a resubmission deadline in the following semester.
